title: Dynasty 3 of Memphis (Nebka to Sneferu)
summary: CFAH AP-50: Dynasty 3 of Memphis, 2029–1922 BC, ending with the death of Sneferu.
description: CFAH-6: "Dynasty 3 began with Nebka in Memphis in 2029 BC" (Argument 2, Memphis Group). CFAH-6 Argument 4 §3 places Abraham in Egypt in the reign of Khufu, 1921 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, Argument 2, Table 1 "Anchor Points for early Egyptian history" #50; Argument 2 "Key Synchronisms for Dynasties 3–8"
chronologies.note: CFAH-6 Table 1: "Dynasty 3 of Memphis, ends with death of Sneferu"
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.

chronologies.citation: Taking Africa for Jesus, ch. 2 "Egypt (Part 1)", PDF p. 18 (printed p. 18)
chronologies.note: Seneferu (Sneferu), builder of the Bent Pyramid, ruled about this time. Differs from the sort year (2029 BC, cfah-anchor) by 253 years.
